title: Every key, a path
lead: One extension in the config, and the keys read as members of t: t.home.title() beside t('home.title'), completed segment by segment and typed from the generated schema.

tree.title: Completed as you type
tree.text: Each segment completes in the editor, and a segment the catalogue lacks is a type error, exactly as a wrong key is in the string form.

string.title: The string form stays
string.text: t('home.title') still works. A key known only at runtime, from a CMS or a prop, keeps it.

runtime.title: One runtime
runtime.text: Every member call goes through the instance's own t, so a key resolves, falls back and fails soft as the string form does.
